description: This file defines utilities for UUID generation, including a type for crypto-like objects, a function to generate UUIDs using crypto APIs, and internal functions for byte manipulation and warnings.

methods.name: function uuidFromBytes(bytes: Uint8Array): string { uuidFromBytes

methods.name: function warnWeakCryptoOnce() { warnWeakCryptoOnce
methods.description: Logs a warning message once if the crypto API is missing or insecure for UUID generation.

methods.description: Generates a UUID string using the provided crypto-like object or the global crypto API, with fallback to warnings and errors if unavailable.
